verdict.rationale: Kling's own site describes a built-in Agent that users can delegate to: it brainstorms, writes scripts, and generates images, videos, and storyboards, then refines videos over multiple post-production rounds. It also offers Skills that produce assets in parallel and a node workspace that preserves context. The MCP/CLI item covers external agents driving Kling, a different story, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the agent's scope, autonomy and limits; independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
